description: Blog hosting service definitions with publishing, feed and pricing metadata

hosts.description: Domain suffixes under which user blogs are served (subdomain or path based)

costs.description: Pricing classification of the service itself

type.description: blog = classic blog platform; microblog = tumblelog/short-form; newsletter = email-first publishing; notes = single-page/anonymous publishing; pages = static site hosting where blogs run via own generator; builder = WYSIWYG site builder with blog module

status.description: active = signups and publishing work; restricted = publishing limited to certain users; no_new_registrations = existing blogs live, no new signups; discontinued = service shut down

public.description: Whether anyone can sign up and publish

feeds.description: Syndication feed formats emitted per blog; absent = no feed

post_methods.description: How posts can be created: web = browser editor; api = programmatic API; email = post-by-email; git = git push (static generators); external-sync = authored in an external app/notebook that syncs; mobile-app = dedicated app; telegram-bot = via Telegram bot

markdown.description: Posts can be authored in Markdown

custom_domain.description: Users can attach their own domain (free or paid)

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the provider's legal seat

hosted.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country where the provider's service site resolves

cloud.description: Cloud/CDN operator hosting the service site
